content.text: {"heavy-calm":"Those two clenched fists, knuckle to knuckle, won't let you sink into stillness. They offer a quiet heaviness something firm to push against.","mid-calm":"For an unhurried mood, the cream ground and plain olive bands keep things orderly, even as the fists meet at the center with held strength.","bright-calm":"The warm yellow lettering brings a gentle light, though the clenched hands hold a tension your easy mood can watch from a comfortable distance.","heavy-mid":"Two fists pressed together, one sleeve rough and patched, one crisp with a cufflink: a grave, thoughtful picture of kinship strained across difference.","mid-mid":"Balanced symmetry runs through this 1938 poster, the two arms angling in from either side to meet evenly, steady as a handshake that is also a standoff.","bright-mid":"Golden yellow letters fanning across the top lend a hopeful lift, and the meeting fists read as two people refusing to let go of each other.","heavy-charged":"If you feel stormy, these knuckles grinding together carry that same pressure, a tense deadlock drawn in blunt olive and black.","mid-charged":"Restless energy lives in the bold slanted lettering and the arms thrusting inward, all force gathered at one point where the fists collide.","bright-charged":"The bouncing yellow headline has real exuberance, and the fists bumping at center turn defiance into something spirited and alive."}

{"heavy-calm":"When you feel quiet and inward, the warm cream paper and simple two-color printing offer a gentle nudge outward, a small reminder that someone once promised an evening of laughter.","mid-calm":"The layout has an unhurried order to it, with red and black lettering stacked in tidy rows on soft cream, easy to take in at a resting pace.","bright-calm":"There is warmth in that pale peach ground and the hand-drawn faces, a cheerful old handbill that can sit lightly on a wall without asking much of you.","heavy-mid":"If your mood is grave, the helmeted face scowling beside the big red script gives weight back, though the poster leans toward mischief rather than gloom.","mid-mid":"Steady and everyday, this is a working theater bill from 1936, its sturdy lettering doing its plain job of telling a city where to go.","bright-mid":"The sweeping red script of Censored, with its little cross underneath, carries an easy, hopeful wink that suits a warm and open frame of mind.","heavy-charged":"Your stormy energy finds a defiant partner here: a tense standoff between the wary woman and the stern soldier, turned into comedy instead of conflict.","mid-charged":"Restless type tumbles across this sheet in shifting sizes and angles, the slanted script word Shocked practically leaning forward, alert and ready to go.","bright-charged":"Bold red lettering bursting at every angle shares your exuberance, a playful shout from a theater that wanted the whole street to hear about its comedy."}
